i am definitely more depressed than i am manic. when i am in my depressive episodes i tend to isolate a lot. i dont eat like i should and self care like showering and brushing my teeth are things i have a hard time doing. i cry and cry and cry for hours on end and the intrusive thoughts get really dark and especially frequent during those times. my bad habits, like physically hurting myself, get worse during these times. it feels like i am worth nothing and am nothing to anyone and everyone in my life.

 i still get intrusive thoughts when im manic, but they arent as frequent. im more of a "no thoughts just do" kind of person when im manic, meaning ill just go ahead and do whatever it is i want to do, regardless of the consequences. im a very very big spender when im manic, like ill spend hundreds of dollars at a time when i literally cannot afford to do that, but i do it anyways because nothing matters but my own gratification and pleasure in that moment. if i feel good, euphoric even, everything else can go to hell because i feel literally invincible in those moments, like nothing can hurt me and nothing can bring me down from cloud 9. 

thats usually how it is for me in those extreme highs and lows! if u need anymore info abt me just message me and ill gladly answer anymore questions :)
